product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Column Mount for Dual Portrait and Landscape Displays Fits 32 to 65 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Column Mount for Dual Portrait and Landscape Displays, Fits 32" to 65" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Column Mount for Dual Landscape or Portrait Displays is designed to mount two flat panel displays back to back on a single structural column, providing two-direction visibility without increasing floor footprint. Supporting landscape or portrait-oriented 32" to 65" displays, this mount is suited for indoor commercial environments including retail floors, transportation hubs, and corporate lobbies where audiences approach from multiple directions.Mounts two flat panel displays back to back on a single structural column for dual-direction visibilitySupports 43" to 65" portrait displays and 32" to 65" landscape displays with a maximum load capacity of 66 lbs (30 kgs) per screenCompatible with VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×400 mm for broad display compatibilityMechanical tilt capability for optimized viewing anglesIdeal for retail floors, transportation hubs, and corporate lobbies where two-sided visibility is requiredDual back to back display configuration without increasing floor footprintProfessional installation recommended; inspect mounting at minimum every 3 monthsDesigned for indoor commercial use only DUAL BACK TO BACK DISPLAY CONFIGURATIONEngineered to support two landscape or portrait-oriented displays mounted back to back on a single column, delivering visibility from two directions simultaneously without requiring additional floor space or separate mounting structures. COLUMN MOUNTED INSTALLATIONAttaches directly to a structural column, making it an effective solution for open commercial spaces where wall mounting is not available and floor-mounted structures would obstruct traffic flow. SUPPORTS 32"–65" LANDSCAPE OR PORTRAIT DISPLAYSAccommodates landscape-oriented flat panel displays from 32 inches to 65 inches per screen or 43 inches to 65 inches in portrait-oriented displays, with a maximum load capacity of 66 lbs (30 kgs) per display and VESA compatibility from 100×100 to 400×400 mm. COMMERCIAL GRADE CONSTRUCTIONBuilt for demanding commercial environments with heavy-duty construction and included column attachment hardware.
